prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: The trend champion is rf (avg_trend_corr=1.0) which perfectly tracks the upward trend in both folds. ARIMA leads seasonality capture (avg_seasonal_corr=0.5378) despite poor overall RMSE. CWT_catboost wins overall (RMSE=110.97) with balanced early/late performance. High RMSE spread (15.26) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.30) suggest robust median/trimmed_mean combinations over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
